import { get } from 'svelte/store'
import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'
import { createGenerationBusyCoordinator, shouldBlockTopLevelGeneration } from './generationBusy'

describe('generation busy coordinator', () => {
    test('legacy client writes and server ownership both feed the public busy store', () => {
        const state = createGenerationBusyCoordinator()

        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(false)
        state.doingChat.set(true)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(true)
        state.doingChat.set(false)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(false)

        state.setServerBusy(true)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(true)
        state.doingChat.set(false)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(true)
        state.setServerBusy(false)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(false)
    })

    test('releasing server ownership never clears an independent client generation', () => {
        const state = createGenerationBusyCoordinator()

        state.doingChat.set(true)
        state.setServerBusy(true)
        state.setServerBusy(false)

        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(true)
        state.doingChat.set(false)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(false)
    })

    test('server-to-client fallback handoff has no observable false transition', () => {
        const state = createGenerationBusyCoordinator()
        const seen: boolean[] = []
        const unsubscribe = state.doingChat.subscribe((value) => seen.push(value))

        state.setServerBusy(true)
        state.handoffServerToClient()

        expect(get(state.orchestrating)).toBe(false)
        expect(get(state.doingChat)).toBe(true)
        expect(seen).toEqual([false, true])

        state.doingChat.set(false)
        expect(seen).toEqual([false, true, false])
        unsubscribe()
    })

    test('an active generation blocks direct top-level re-entry except its exact fallback', () => {
        expect(shouldBlockTopLevelGeneration(true, -1, false)).toBe(true)
        expect(shouldBlockTopLevelGeneration(true, -1, true)).toBe(false)
        expect(shouldBlockTopLevelGeneration(true, 0, false)).toBe(false)
        expect(shouldBlockTopLevelGeneration(false, -1, false)).toBe(false)
    })
})
